proposed_widenings.name: create_object_operation
proposed_widenings.justification: Dancing Lights' core effect is creating persistent floating magical objects. OngoingOperation only allows roll_modifier and damage_on_hit; there is no variant for object creation. The v4 atom create_object exists but is not reachable from any OngoingOperation variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You create up to four torch-size lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover for the duration.

proposed_widenings.name: reposition_objects_operation
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell grants a recurring optional Bonus Action each turn to move the created lights up to 60 feet, subject to range and adjacency constraints. No current OngoingOperation variant expresses a recurring per-turn optional cost that repositions created objects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell's range.

notes: Dancing Lights fits the ongoing_effect family structurally (concentration, point range, action casting time, cantrip level 0) but fails at OngoingOperation: neither roll_modifier nor damage_on_hit describes creating hovering lights. The v4 atom create_object exists but there is no corresponding OngoingOperation variant. The bonus-action reposition mechanic is also not expressible; it is a recurring optional per-turn cost for moving created objects — distinct from mark transfer (event-triggered) and from anything currently in OngoingOperation. No dhall/json/trace authored because no honest encoding is possible without these variants.
